## Verification

- [ ] `make verify`
- [ ] `make smoke`
- [ ] `make race` for concurrency/store changes
- [ ] Added or updated fixtures/evals
- [ ] No secrets or customer data
- [ ] Security boundaries reviewed
- [ ] Documentation and rollback updated
- [ ] Evidence tier is labeled; CI or Mock output is not presented as live evidence
- [ ] If live work: authorization reference, non-production scope, and cleanup/retention decision are recorded
- [ ] Independent acceptance is recorded by a reviewer who did not implement the change
